source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.2 with Figs. 3.6 to 3.10 and Examples 3.2 and 3.3 (PDF 59-62).

blocks.text: Newton ka doosra qanoon kehta hai ke jism par force lage to usi direction mein acceleration paida hota hai. Agar force chalte jism ki velocity ki direction mein lage to sirf speed badalti hai, direction wahi rehti hai. Lekin agar daire mein chalte jism par force hamesha velocity ke perpendicular (amood) lage to direction badalti hai magar speed wahi rehti hai. Aisi force jism mein radial (centripetal, markaz ki taraf) acceleration paida kar ke use daire mein chalati hai; ise centripetal force (markaz ki taraf khenchne wali force) kehte hain. Fig. 3.6(a) mein dori se bandhi gend horizontal daire mein ghumai ja rahi hai. Agar dori toot jaye to gend daire mein nahi chalti. Agar gend nuqta A par ho jab dori toote (Fig. 3.6b) to gend seedhi line AB par chali jati hai, jo A par daire ki tangent hai.

blocks.alt: Ek shakhs ufuqi rangeen disc ke neeche khara hai jo daire ki satah dikhati hai. Us ka utha hua haath markaz par dori pakarta hai; dori daire ke kinare par gend tak jati hai. Dori par teer F gend se haath ki taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6(a): Dori se bandhi gend ufuqi daire mein ghumai ja rahi hai (kitab ki Figure 3.6(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Markaz O wala daira, us par teer anticlockwise harkat dikhata hai. Daire par nuqte A se O tak lakeer, us par teer F O ki taraf. A se tangent ke saath dashed teer B par khatam hota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6(b): Agar dori A par toot jaye to gend tangent AB par chalti hai (kitab ki Figure 3.6(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Dori tootte hi markaz ki taraf khenchne wali force khatam ho jati hai, is liye gend us lamhe ki velocity ki direction mein, yani nuqta A par tangent AB ke saath, seedhi chali jati hai (Newton ka pehla qanoon).
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Is liye yaksan speed se daire mein chalte jism ki direction har nuqte par badalne ke liye force chahiye. Yeh force speed nahi badalti, sirf direction badalti hai; yeh radius ke saath perpendicular force hai jo hamesha jism ko daire ke markaz ki taraf khenchti hai. Har nuqte par is ki direction tangential velocity ke perpendicular hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Daire par kai nuqte, har ek par tangent ke saath velocity ka teer v; sab teer barabar lambe hain magar jism clockwise ghoomte hue un ki simt badalti jati hai. Ek nuqte par agla velocity teer usi dum (tail) par la kar banaya gaya hai, dashed lakeer yeh muntaqili dikhati hai, aur dono siron ko jorne wala chhota teer, jo daire ke andar ki taraf hai, delta v hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 59): dairawi harkat mein harkat ki simt lagatar badalti hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Daire ke har nuqte par velocity ka teer tangent ke saath hai, aur har nuqte par is ki direction alag hai. Velocity ki miqdar (speed) wahi hai magar direction lagatar badal rahi hai; isi badlao ke liye centripetal force chahiye.

blocks.text: Particle ke seedhe raste ko mod kar daire mein badalne ke liye jo force chahiye use centripetal force kehte hain.
blocks.title: Centripetal force

blocks.text: Mass m ka jism radius r ke daire mein velocity v se chal raha ho to centripetal force F꜀:
Yahan a = v²/r centripetal acceleration hai jis ki direction daire ke markaz ki taraf hai. Chunke v = rω, is liye:

blocks.title: Example 3.2
blocks.problem: CD 210 rpm (revolutions per minute) se ghoom rahi hai. CD ke bahri kinare (rim) par kisi nuqte ka radial acceleration kya hai? CD ka diameter 12 cm hai.
steps: Pehle 210 rpm ko revolutions per second (Hz) mein badlein: f = 210 rev/min × (1 min / 60 s) = 3.5 rev/s = 3.5 Hz
Har chakkar mein CD 2π radian ghoomti hai: ω = 2πf = 2π rad/rev × 3.5 rev/s = 7.0π rad s⁻¹
a = ω²r = (7.0π rad s⁻¹)² × 0.06 m ≈ 29 m s⁻²
blocks.answer: Rim par radial acceleration ≈ 29 m s⁻² (g ka taqreeban teen guna).

blocks.text: Kitab ω wali line mein units ulte likhti hai: “2π rev/min × 3.5 min/s”. Sahi: har chakkar 2π rad hai aur f = 3.5 rev/s, is liye ω = 2π rad/rev × 3.5 rev/s = 7.0π rad s⁻¹. Jawab wahi rehta hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Tez raftar par mur kar urna (curved flight) bohat bari centripetal force maangta hai, is liye yeh kartab (stunt) khatarnak hai, chahe jahaz aapas mein zyada qareeb na bhi hon.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
Example 3.3
blocks.problem: Dori ke sire par bandhi gend gravity ke asar mein radius r ke vertical daire mein ghumai jati hai (Fig. 3.7). Jab gend raste ke sab se oonche nuqte A par ho aur us ki speed v ho, to dori mein tension kitni hogi?
steps: Gend daire mein chale, is ke liye us par lagne wali kul force centripetal force ke barabar honi chahiye.
Nuqta A par do forces neeche (markaz ki taraf) lagti hain: dori ki tension T aur gend ka wazan w. Dono radius ke saath hain, is liye in ka jor centripetal force deta hai:
T + w = mv²/r, aur w = mg
blocks.answer: Agar v²/r = g ho to T = 0: sirf wazan hi centripetal force ka kaam kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: Amoodi daira, markaz O aur sab se ooncha nuqta A. A par naranji teer v tangent ke saath baen taraf hai, aur AO ke saath do neeche ke teer hain: chhota neela w aur lamba hara T. Daire par teer dikhata hai ke gend anticlockwise ghoomti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.7: Amoodi daire mein ghoomti gend: oopar nuqte A par tension T aur wazan w dono AO ke saath (kitab ki Figure 3.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Sab se oonche nuqte A par tension T aur wazan w dono neeche markaz O ki taraf hain, aur velocity v tangent ke saath (bayen taraf) hai. Isi liye A par T + w = mv²/r likha gaya.

blocks.text: Centripetal force ki misalein
Har circular ya orbital harkat ke liye centripetal force chahiye, jo koi na koi cheez deti hai:

items: Gend ko dori se horizontal daire mein ghumayein to dori ki tension centripetal force deti hai.
Turntable (ghoomti plate) par rakhi cheez ke liye friction (ragar) centripetal force hai.
Gravitational force ki wajah se Zameen Suraj ke gird, aur Chand aur masnooi (artificial) satellites Zameen ke gird ghoomte hain.
Magnetic force jo charged particle ki velocity ke perpendicular ho, use seedhe raste se mod kar daire mein chalati hai.

Sarak par murti gari ko bhi centripetal force chahiye, jo tyres aur sarak ki friction deti hai. Sarak phislan wali ho to tez speed par friction kafi nahi hoti; gari mur nahi pati aur phisal (skid) sakti hai ya ulat sakti hai. Is liye moron par highway ko banked banaya jata hai: track ka bahri kinara andar wale kinare se thora ooncha rakha jata hai.

blocks.text: Bohat tez liye jane wale moron par banked tracks chahiye, kyunke wahan sirf friction kafi centripetal force nahi de sakti.
blocks.title: Tid-bits

blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke friction centripetal force ke liye “energy” nahi de sakti. Centripetal force ek force hai, energy nahi; friction (aur banked track) khud yeh force deti hai. Sahi jumla: sirf friction kafi centripetal force nahi de sakti.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Centripetal force ke istemal (applications)

Cheez centripetal force ki wajah se daire mein chalti hai. Agar lagne wali force zaroori centripetal force se kam ho to cheez daire ke markaz se door (bahar) chali jati hai. Centrifuge (Fig. 3.8a) isi usool par kaam karta hai.

Centrifuge: laboratory ka bohat kaam ka aala. Yeh mixture mein se bhari (denser) aur halke particles alag karta hai. Mixture ko kuch waqt tak bohat tez ghumaya jata hai. Sample tubes mein bhari particles tube ke pende (bottom) mein beth jate hain aur halke particles oopar aa jate hain (Fig. 3.8b).

blocks.alt: Amoodi shaft par hub aur do ufuqi baazu. Har baazu ke sire par holder ek sample tube pakarta hai jo bahar ki taraf leti hai, us ka band gol sira shaft se door. Shaft ke gird mura teer gardish dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.8(b): Centrifuge ki sample tubes, jin mein ghani (denser) zarraat tah (bottom) par baith jate hain (kitab ki Figure 3.8(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ghoomte waqt tubes bahar ki taraf letti hain. Bhari particles ko daire mein rakhne ke liye zyada centripetal force chahiye; jab yeh kafi nahi milti to woh bahar, yani tube ke band sire (bottom) ki taraf chale jate hain.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Washing machine ka dryer bhi centrifuge ke usool par chalta hai. Is mein ek lamba cylinder hota hai jis ki deewar mein saikron chhote soorakh hote hain. Geele kapre is mein dal kar cylinder ko apne axis par tezi se ghumaya jata hai. Pani bahar deewaron ki taraf jata hai aur soorakhon se nikal jata hai; yun kapre jaldi sookh jate hain.

Cream separator doodh se cream alag karne ka aala hai. Is mein doodh ko tezi se ghumaya jata hai. Doodh halke aur bhari particles ka mixture hai; ghumane par halke particles (cream) axis ke qareeb jama hote hain aur bhari particles bahar chale jate hain, is liye cream aasani se alag ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt: 0.5 m lambi dori zyada se zyada 35.6 N tension sah sakti hai. 0.5 kg ka patthar is dori se vertical daire mein zyada se zyada kis speed se ghumaya ja sakta hai? Aur car ke liye tez speed par morna mushkil kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Tension daire ke sab se neeche wale nuqte par sab se zyada hoti hai, jahan T − mg = mv²/r. To 35.6 − 0.5 × 9.8 = 0.5 × v² / 0.5, yani v² = 30.7 aur v ≈ 5.5 m s⁻¹. Car ke liye zaroori centripetal force mv²/r speed ke square ke saath barhti hai; tez speed par tyres ki friction kafi nahi rehti aur car phisal jati hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Velocity ke perpendicular force sirf direction badalti hai: centripetal force F꜀ = mv²/r = mrω², radius ke saath markaz ki taraf. Force khatam ho to jism tangent par seedha chala jata hai.
Vertical daire ki chotti par: T = m(v²/r − g). Example 3.2: CD ke rim par a ≈ 29 m s⁻².
Centripetal force dene wale: dori ki tension, friction (turntable, tyres), gravity (orbits), magnetic force; tez moron par banked sarkein.
Istemal: centrifuge, washing machine ka dryer, cream separator.
